desc: Ideate high-level approaches and derive the shortest-path/gadget characterization.
Implement a brute-force oracle and analyze small-graph patterns.
Complete/fix the O(N+M) solver implementation as a full runnable program and make it pass the three samples.

Stress-test the completed solver against the exact BFS oracle on random small connected graphs and targeted cases (D=1, unique/multiple shortest paths, internal side edges, endpoint branches/cycles, bypasses, bipartite/non-bipartite); fix any mismatches.
Optimize and performance-test the final Python implementation for N,M up to 2e5 (few BFS passes, O(N+M) memory, fast I/O).
